comparison.objective: Measure a pin diameter with a handheld digital caliper.
comparison.physical_skill: Align jaws squarely, close with very low force, stabilize a reading and return the tool.
comparison.success_condition: Accurate low-force reading with both jaws contacting, followed by tool replacement and hand clearance.
comparison.reason: Tests precision metrology and force control, with no many-body material separation or recovery yield.
